title: West Facade
notes: A tall tower volume and a flight of steps
address: Bosques de las Lomas, Mexico City

detail.intro: The west elevation, drawn at 1:50, stacks a tall shaded tower against a lower block, with a flight of steps descending along its base. A thin outline behind marks the height of the wall beyond.

blocks.html: [Photographs of the west side of the house and garden still to come.]
